payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively iterates over all pairs of indices (i,j) to consider each contiguous middle sector, computing difference between its angle sum and the rest.
payload.rationale: The solution uses two nested loops to enumerate all possible contiguous sectors (without wrapping) and computes the complement sum, effectively checking all bipartitions. This is a complete search, specifically backtracking-style enumeration over the solution space, though implemented iteratively.
